description: Validation test cases for React application patterns, routing, forms, error boundaries, TypeScript contracts, testing, and SSR hydration.

testCases.description: Controlled to uncontrolled state transition caused by undefined initial form state

findings.description: Input value prop initialized to undefined switches from uncontrolled to controlled state upon receiving data, triggering React runtime warnings and desynchronizing input state.

expected.notes: Controlled inputs must have a defined fallback string such as value={bio ?? ''} or initial state defaulting to empty string.
SafeUserProfileEditor initializes state with fallback string and guarantees non-undefined value prop at all times.

testCases.description: Async event handler error unhandled due to reliance on React ErrorBoundary

findings.description: Async error thrown inside onClick event handler is not caught by standard React Error Boundaries, resulting in unhandled rejection and silent failure without user feedback.

expected.notes: React Error Boundaries do not catch async or event handler errors; must use local try/catch or showBoundary from react-error-boundary.
SafeSubscriptionCancelButton wraps async operations in try/catch and provides accessible inline error alert.

testCases.description: Conflicting optional boolean flags allowing impossible prop state combinations

findings.description: Component props use ambiguous multiple optional boolean flags (isSuccess, isError, isWarning) allowing contradictory simultaneous states instead of a strict discriminated union.

expected.notes: Refactor to discriminated union variant prop with mutually exclusive fields.
SafeNotificationBanner uses a strict discriminated union with variant prop ensuring compile-time type exclusivity.

testCases.description: Synchronous assertion on asynchronous UI update in React Testing Library

findings.description: Synchronous getByRole query executed immediately following asynchronous user event without waitFor or findByRole synchronization, creating flaky test failures.

expected.notes: Asynchronous state changes must be waited on using screen.findBy* or waitFor(() => ...).
testSafeFeedbackSubmission uses await screen.findByRole to synchronize async DOM appearance.

testCases.description: Immediate browser API access during render causing SSR hydration mismatch

findings.description: Directly evaluating window.innerWidth in component render body creates divergent server vs client initial markup, triggering React hydration mismatch errors.

expected.notes: Client-only window properties must be queried in useEffect or styled via CSS media queries.
SafeResponsiveNavbar ensures identical initial markup and performs window checks within useEffect post-mount.
